title: com.enroll arguments: take a Project's responder slot for a capability (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: The responder is the authenticated session; a supplied process id, model name, origin, launcher label or descriptor never authorizes it. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments). Any participant reply of the request's target Project moves a queued request to answered, whatever the slot's state, so a session reads the slot in com.status first: active, it leaves the request to that holder, calls nothing and asks no one; otherwise it calls com.enroll and does no work unless it is taken. Refused fenced, as active. Refused not_authorized: with the slot stale, absent at a later generation, or no generation shown, it sends no reply and asks the operator; absent at generation 0 (no service ever held it), one session replies once that it cannot take the request now, why and what would lift it, and asks the operator. Refused with any other code, it sends no reply and declines nothing: with retryable true (held among them) it tries again once the cause is gone, otherwise it asks the operator. A session that enrolls answers each request it claims in the same turn by a com.progress note or a fenced reply carrying the state, and settles it with com.accept, then com.complete (DEC-0152 SA-2, SA-6).

capability.description: A capability of the caller's Project; the slot's Project comes from the endpoint, and the host's responder grant for it is checked in the same statement.
